{{Quote|Zap rod. If I have to use it, you'll remember it.|The box guard, to [[Cassian Jeron Andor]]|<ref name="Narkina" />}}
A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''box guard''' was an [[Imperial officer]] in a an [[Unidentified Imperial factory facility|Imperial factory facility]] part of an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|Prison Complex]] on [[Narkina 5]]. This box guard was tasked with delivering the prisoners to [[Kino Loy]].<ref name="Narkina" /> During the [[Narkina 5 prison escape]], while delivering a new prisoner, [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] and [[Birnok]] stopped the platform he was on. The box guard was zapped with his own [[zap rod]] and toppled off the platform onto the flooding, [[Tunqstoid steel|electrified]] floor.<ref name="One Way Out">{{Andor|One Way Out}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The box guard appeared in the eighth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]." He was played by [[Anton Valensi]].<ref name="Narkina" />
